hook: GHMC razes *30-year-old* huts on a Tolichowki nala
hook_b: GHMC razes *30-year-old* huts on a Tolichowki nala
tldr: GHMC ran an anti-encroachment drive at Hakeempet, Tolichowki, removing huts over a stormwater drain amid resident protests.

beats.what: The drive began at 9 am at Hakeempet; some residents resisted, others welcomed it, per Siasat.
beats.why: GHMC officials said the encroachments were obstructing water flow in the stormwater nala.
beats.care: Blocked nalas are a flooding risk for nearby streets in the rains.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Police said there was mild tension but no detentions were made.

cards.q: Clearing nala encroachments: what matters most?

qs: Where do the people who lived in these huts go next?
How many other Hyderabad nalas have similar encroachments?

facts.t: A Hakeempet resident told Siasat the spot had drawn loitering for the *past 35 years*.

steps.e: Shelters 10-15 ft into the drain removed

viz.verdict: Drain cleared; huts that stood ~30 years are gone

watch: Whether GHMC extends the drive to other nalas in the Golconda zone.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: GHMC razes 30-yr-old huts over Tolichowki stormwater nala

fact: GHMC razed *30-year-old* huts built over a Tolichowki stormwater nala on Thursday.
twist: Officials said the shelters stuck *10 to 15 feet* into the drain; the drive followed Telangana High Court orders, per Siasat.
